title: Renewed, app not visible on my subscriptions
body: 30 EUR were taken from my card, the app does not stated to renew on my phone subscription… I cannot request a refund because in App store it states it was 0 EUR…. I want my money back.
author: Anita199992

title: It’s a ripoff
body: Everyone be aware it’s a rip off!! after making a one dollar per day subscription they will rip you off $30 and they’re not gonna give it back to you!! One mistake, one wrong click, and then in app purchase, which is not refundable, the whole story is set up for this. Stay away!
author: Peter404R

title: Stole my payment info
body: This app charged me without ever giving them my payment information! Never sent any information about payment. It seemed like a free app, totally confusing. I want my money back!
author: Trenata

title: Habio
body: Please make it available in Hungarian as well
author: nikcsa05

title: Good app, bad ending
body: The app itself looks great, still, I did not get to like it. So unfortunate that after the 3 day trial for 1 Euro it wanted to charge my bank account with almost 30 Euros for a longer period - I did not receive a proper answer from Help Desk if it was an in-build term in the 3 day trial or a fraud. My credit card was frozen by my bank. Be aware with terms and conditions!
author: Ann8492
